page.content:
Gedeo origin known for floral, tea-like washed arabicas.

How Yirgacheffe connects

  • Location: Ethiopia — Yirgacheffe is an Ethiopian origin region for washed arabica.
  • Item: Coffea arabica — Yirgacheffe lots are Coffea arabica sold under a place name.
  • Topic: Coffee terroir — Yirgacheffe is a type specimen of coffee sold as taste of place.

What is Yirgacheffe?

Yirgacheffe is an Ethiopian woreda whose washed lots became a third-wave type specimen: jasmine, citrus, and a light body sold under the place name.

Key threads lead to Ethiopia, Coffea arabica and Coffee terroir.
